show.description: Aditya, a rich CEO living like a beggar to stay hidden, falls in love with Kriti—the only one who treats him with kindness. When her fiancé cheats on her, Aditya enters a fake marriage to protect her family and secretly keeps saving her. The truth about him shocks Kriti at first, but she realizes his love is real and chooses to stay with him forever.
